jobs.title: Chief Product Officer (CPO) – Footwear (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Pammys ist in wenigen Jahren auf über 1,3 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen. Jetzt bauen wir die Product Organisation für unsere nächste Wachstumsphase: neue Kategorien, höhere Volumen, internationale Märkte und ein global skalierbares Produktionsnetzwerk.

Dafür suchen wir einen Chief Product Officer (CPO) – Footwear (m/w/d), der unsere gesamte Product Organisation aufbaut, führt und auf das nächste Level bringt.

Wir suchen keinen CPO, der Produkt nur aus Strategie-Meetings kennt.

Wir suchen einen Builder und Operator mit tiefem Footwear-Know-how, der weiß, wie man Product Development, Engineering, Design, Merchandising, Sourcing, Production, Quality und Product Marketing zu einer leistungsfähigen Organisation verbindet.

Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Gründern unsere langfristige Produkt- und Kategoriestrategie und verantwortest gleichzeitig, dass diese operativ funktioniert.

Wenn ein Development-Prozess nicht funktioniert, gehst du rein.

Wenn Qualität, Costing oder Timelines nicht stimmen, willst du verstehen warum und löst das Problem gemeinsam mit deinem Team.

Wenn entscheidende Kompetenzen fehlen, baust du sie auf.

Ein zentraler Bestandteil deiner Rolle ist der Aufbau unserer internationalen Product- und Sourcing-Struktur in China und perspektivisch weiteren Produktionsmärkten wie Vietnam.

Dein Ziel ist klar:

Bessere Produkte. Schnellere Entwicklungszyklen. Höhere Qualität. Stärkere Margen. Klare Ownership. Eine Product Organisation, die mit Pammys skalieren kann.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die gesamte Product Organisation von Pammys und entwickelst Strukturen, Verantwortlichkeiten, Prozesse und Führung konsequent weiter.
  • Du baust leistungsfähige Bereiche für Product Development & Engineering, Sourcing & Production, Merchandising & Planning, Footwear Design, Product Management, Quality sowie Product Marketing & Consumer Insights auf.
  • Du rekrutierst, führst und entwickelst starke Führungskräfte und Spezialisten und baust eine Organisation, die nicht dauerhaft vom CPO abhängig ist.
  • Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit den Gründern die langfristige Product- und Category Strategy und entscheidest, welche Kategorien, Silhouetten und Produktwelten Pammys zukünftig aufbaut.
  • Du steuerst den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess von der ersten Idee über Design, Construction, Material Selection, Sampling, Fit und Testing bis zur Serienproduktion und Markteinführung.
  • Du optimierst unsere Entwicklungsprozesse mit dem Ziel, Development Timelines zu verkürzen, Iterationen zu reduzieren und Produkte schneller zur Production Readiness zu bringen.
  • Du entwickelst unser internationales Factory- und Supplier Network weiter und führst strategische Verhandlungen zu Costing, Kapazitäten, Qualität, Lead Times und Produktionsbedingungen.
  • Du baust gemeinsam mit uns unsere Product-, Development- und Sourcing-Präsenz in China auf und entwickelst dort langfristig ein leistungsfähiges lokales Team.
  • Du etablierst klare QA- und QC-Strukturen und stellst sicher, dass definierte Qualitätsstandards nicht nur auf dem Papier existieren, sondern in der Produktion konsequent umgesetzt werden.
  • Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit Merchandising & Planning die kommerzielle Steuerung unseres Portfolios über Target Cost, Einkaufspreise, Verkaufspreise, Margen, Mengen, Launch-Zeitpunkte und Produktprofitabilität.
  • Du etablierst klare Product Ownership, sodass jedes relevante Produkt einen verantwortlichen Owner hat, der Development, Design, Sourcing, Quality und Launch über alle Funktionen hinweg vorantreibt.
  • Du verknüpfst Produktentwicklung stärker mit Consumer Insights und Marketing und stellst sicher, dass neue Produkte auf reale Kundenbedürfnisse, klare Positionierung und kommerzielles Skalierungspotenzial ausgerichtet sind.
  • Du arbeitest regelmäßig direkt mit unseren Teams, Fabriken und Produktionspartnern in Asien und steigst bei kritischen Themen auch selbst tief in operative Produkt- und Produktionsfragen ein.


Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung auf Director-, VP-, SVP- oder C-Level im Product-Bereich einer Footwear Brand oder eines vergleichbaren internationalen Consumer-Unternehmens.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Skalierung einer multidisziplinären Product Organisation.
  • Tiefgehendes Know-how in Footwear Development, Engineering, Construction, Materials, Fit, Sampling, Testing und Production.
  • Langjährige direkte Erfahrung mit Footwear-Fabriken und Produktionspartnern in China sowie idealerweise ein belastbares Netzwerk im asiatischen Beschaffungsmarkt.
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Sourcing, Costing, Supplier Management, Production Planning und kommerziellen Verhandlungen.
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Skalierung von Produktportfolios, Kategorien und internationalen Produktlinien.
  • Starkes kommerzielles Verständnis für Marge, Pricing, Herstellkosten, Volumen, Sortiment und Produktprofitabilität.
  • Du kannst Strategie auf C-Level entwickeln und gleichzeitig operativ tief genug einsteigen, um komplexe Product-, Development- oder Production-Probleme selbst zu verstehen und voranzutreiben.
  • Du bist ein Builder und fühlst dich in einer Organisation wohl, in der Strukturen nicht vollständig vorgegeben sind, sondern von dir geschaffen werden.
  • Du führst mit hohen Standards, klarer Verantwortung und starker Execution.
  • Du triffst Entscheidungen schnell, datenbasiert und mit ausgeprägtem unternehmerischem Verständnis.
  • Sehr gutes Englisch sowie hohe internationale Reisebereitschaft, insbesondere nach China und zu unseren Produktionspartnern.
  • Standortnähe zu Hamburg beziehungsweise die Bereitschaft, regelmäßig vor Ort mit unserem Team zu arbeiten.


Deine Vorteile bei Pammys

  • Echte C-Level Ownership: Du verantwortest die gesamte Product Organisation und damit eine der wichtigsten Säulen unserer zukünftigen Unternehmensstrategie.
  • Build instead of manage: Du übernimmst keine fertige Konzernorganisation, sondern kannst Teams, Strukturen, Prozesse und Verantwortlichkeiten aktiv aufbauen.
  • Direkter Einfluss auf unser Wachstum: Du entscheidest maßgeblich mit, welche Produkte und Kategorien Pammys in den kommenden Jahren entwickelt und skaliert.
  • Direkter Zugang zu den Gründern: Produktentscheidungen werden schnell getroffen und du bist unmittelbar an den wichtigsten strategischen Entscheidungen beteiligt.
  • Internationaler Scope: Du baust unsere Strukturen in China mit auf und arbeitest direkt mit Fabriken, Produzenten und internationalen Partnern.
  • Hohe Geschwindigkeit: Keine endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen. Wenn wir überzeugt sind, setzen wir um.
  • Starkes Fundament: Du baust auf einer Footwear Brand mit über 1,3 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden auf und gestaltest von hier aus die nächste Wachstumsphase.
  • Großer Gestaltungsspielraum: Du kannst eine Product Organisation entwickeln, die auf Geschwindigkeit, Qualität, Profitabilität und internationale Skalierung ausgelegt ist.
  • Executive Package: Ein der Verantwortung, Erfahrung und dem Impact der Rolle entsprechendes Vergütungspaket inklusive leistungsabhängiger Komponenten.
  • Standort Hamburg mit direkter Nähe zu Gründern, Leadership Team und zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen.

Wir suchen keine Person, die eine bestehende Product Organisation verwaltet.

Wir suchen jemanden, der eine baut.

jobs.description:
About us

At Sierra, we’re building a platform to enable every company in the world to build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We partner with industry leaders such as SoftBank, Uber, Rivian, CLEAR, and Sutter Health. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace. 

About the Role

We're looking for a Deal Operations Manager to sit at the intersection of Sales, Finance, Legal, and Product, helping structure, price, and close complex enterprise deals. You'll be the operational backbone of our sales motion — ensuring deals move quickly, accurately, and profitably from proposal to signature.


What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end deal support: structuring pricing, building proposals, and running approval workflows for enterprise and strategic deals.

  • Partner with Sales to design and maintain deal desk processes, discounting guardrails, and approval matrices that balance speed with governance.

  • Work cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, and Product to unblock non-standard terms, custom packaging, and multi-year/multi-product deals.

  • Build and maintain tools/dashboards (Salesforce, Sheets, or internal systems) to track deal pipeline, cycle time, and win/loss trends.

  • Analyze deal data to identify bottlenecks in the sales cycle and recommend process improvements.

  • Support quote-to-cash processes, ensuring accuracy in contract terms, billing setup, and revenue recognition handoffs.

  • Own special projects related to pricing strategy, packaging, discounting policy, and international deal structures.

  • Leverage AI-native tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) to automate repetitive deal workflows and create scalable systems.


What you'll bring

  • 3+ years of experience in deal desk, sales operations, revenue operations, or management consulting.

  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; comfort with financial modeling and deal economics (discounting, margin, ARR impact).

  • Experience with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and contract/CLM tools (e.g., Ironclad, DocuSign).

  • High attention to detail — you catch pricing errors and contract inconsistencies before they become problems.

  • Ability to manage multiple live deals simultaneously under time pressure without sacrificing accuracy.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting recommendations to Sales leadership and executives.

  • A proactive, builder mentality — comfortable creating process from scratch in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. Other campaign owners run the parallel motions for personas like Product, Engineering, and Developers; your job is to build the strategy, narrative, and channel mix for the Global Operators audience specifically.

This role sits at the intersection of integrated marketing, demand generation, and account-based marketing. You will start from how Marketing, HR, and L&D leaders think, communicate, and buy, then shape DeepL's capabilities into narratives and programs that speak directly to their priorities. You will orchestrate multi-channel campaigns from concept to launch, and partner closely with Product Marketing, SDR, and Field Marketing to bring targeted, personalized programs to personas in our highest-value accounts.. Campaign Strategy & Execution

  • Partner with Product Marketing, Field, Performance, and SDR teams to develop go-to-market programs and nurture streams aligned with persona priorities and regional needs.

Account-Based Marketing (ABM)

jobs.title: Senior PR Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the role

We're looking for a seasoned Senior PR Manager to own Perk's US and UK media presence. This is a high-impact role at the heart of one of our most important strategic priorities: establishing Perk as a leading voice in major business and financial press.

Both markets are fast-growing for Perk, and cutting through in either requires deep journalist relationships, a sharp corporate narrative, and someone who can work at the pace of a major news cycle. You'll be the on-the-ground force behind our Tier 1 media strategy, shaping how our executives show up in the press and building the kind of earned presence no paid campaign can replicate.

This is a role for a natural communicator who understands the nuance of financial and business media, can translate complex tech and AI narratives into compelling stories, and knows how to get a C-suite executive ready for a Bloomberg interview on short notice.


What you'll do

Own the US and UK media strategy: Lead Perk's day-to-day PR activity from proactive pitching and newsjacking to reactive press office and crisis communications. You'll be the primary point of contact for US and UK journalists and the go-to expert on those media landscapes internally.

Build and deepen Tier 1 relationships: Cultivate and maintain genuine relationships with journalists at WSJ, Bloomberg, the FT, CNBC, Forbes and beyond — not just for coverage, but for the kind of background briefings and exclusives that build long-term credibility.

Shape the corporate narrative: Work with senior leadership to develop and maintain Perk's corporate narrative, ensuring our messaging on company growth, financial performance, AI innovation and platform positioning is consistent, compelling and landing with the right audiences.

Drive executive profiling: Partner closely with our C-suite to build their media profiles — crafting commentary, preparing spokespeople for interviews, and developing a proactive profiling strategy that puts our executives in front of the journalists and audiences that matter most.

Translate tech and AI narrative: Work with product and engineering teams to turn Perk's AI and technology innovation into media-ready stories — making complex product developments accessible, relevant and newsworthy for mainstream business press.

Manage PR agency relationships: Brief, manage and hold our US and UK PR agencies accountable to clear KPIs — bringing the rigour and direction needed to get the most out of the partnership while building in-house capability alongside it.

Bring AI into the workflow: Bring AI tools into day-to-day PR operations, from media monitoring and drafting to research and reporting, to make the function faster and sharper without losing judgement or voice.

What we're looking for

Experience

  • Extensive experience in PR or corporate communications with a clear focus on the US and UK market

  • Deep, existing relationships with Tier 1 US and UK financial and business press and proven track record securing earned coverage (digital and broadcast)

  • Financial communications background — experienced handling funding rounds, M&A and business performance narratives

  • Experience building compelling corporate narratives — able to take complex positioning and turn it into a differentiated story that lands with business press

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with senior leadership teams to craft commentary and prepare C-suite spokespeople

  • Strong agency management background — comfortable briefing, managing and holding agencies to account

  • Strong background in B2B technology, fintech or SaaS essential

Skills

  • Sharp editorial judgement — knows what makes a story

  • Strong writer — press releases, bylines, executive commentary and media briefings all to a high standard

  • Confident media trainer and spokesperson coach for C-suite executives

  • Comfortable working with data (survey results, product analytics, market research) and shaping it into a clear, pitchable narrative

  • Commercially minded — understands how PR contributes to pipeline, brand salience and competitive positioning

  • Comfortable building AI into day-to-day PR workflows (drafting, research, monitoring, reporting) to work faster without sacrificing judgement or quality.

Ways of working

  • Self-starter who can own a US and UK PR programme independently and support the Director of Communications on corporate and financial priorities, while collaborating closely with a global team

  • Comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously

  • Data-driven — uses coverage data, share of voice and inbound metrics to inform strategy and demonstrate ROI

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where priorities shift quickly

  • Intellectually curious — reads widely, spots trends early and brings proactive story ideas to the table unprompted

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.title: Product Designer (UX), HCI
jobs.description:
About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

Role

Design how people use AI in real product workflows. This role focuses on building HCI interfaces where users can understand, guide, correct, and stay in control of AI systems that reason and act across multiple steps.

Current UX patterns are not enough for proactive AI products. You will help define new interaction models for how users work with AI, review progress, recover from mistakes, and build trust in the system.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design end-to-end user experiences for AI product surfaces, from concept to shipped product.

  • Create interaction patterns for human-AI workflows, including prompting, review, confirmation, correction, handoff, and recovery.

  • Design interfaces that help users understand what the AI is doing, what it knows, what it is unsure about, and what will happen next.

  • Turn complex, multi-step AI capabilities into flows that are clear, controllable, and usable in everyday contexts.

  • Work closely with product, engineering, and ML teams to define problems, test ideas, and ship quickly.

  • Produce wireframes, flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs for web and mobile.

  • Run lightweight user research and usability tests to identify friction, trust issues, and failure points.

  • Help define reusable HCI design patterns as the product and design system mature.

What You Will Need

  • Experience as a product designer or UX designer, with a portfolio across web or mobile products.

  • Strong skills in interaction design, information hierarchy, and prototyping.

  • Proficiency in Figma and fast iteration workflows.

  • Ability to simplify complex systems and turn unclear product behavior into clear user experiences.

  • Experience working closely with product managers and engineers in fast-moving teams.

  • Comfort working with ambiguity and shaping solutions before requirements are fully defined.

  • Good judgment on usability, edge cases, and failure handling.

  • Clear thinking about trust, control, feedback, and transparency in AI-driven experiences.

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.benefits to billions globally.

jobs.title: Social Content Producer
jobs.description:
Healf is Europe's fastest-growing company.

Number one on the FT1000, number one on the Sifted 100. From £1m to over £100m in under three years, with a small, talent-dense team and an electric culture with day one founder intensity. Now we're aiming for £1bn in the next three.

We curate the world's best wellbeing brands across The Four Pillars™: EAT, MOVE, MIND, SLEEP. That's the first chapter.

The next chapter is harder and more interesting.

We are moving from one market to many, from e-commerce to a technology platform, and from curating wellbeing to defining it. We are a health company, so we think we should act like one.

At its fullest expression, Healf redefines what wellbeing means for tens of millions of people.

Role Overview

The Social Content Producer is a hands-on creative role, focused on the day-to-day ideation, capture, editing, and delivery of Healf’s social content. This person operates at the intersection of creative vision and production execution, fluent in both conceptualisation and hands-on craft. This person is a natural storyteller with a genuine passion for social media and wellbeing, demonstrated through a portfolio of engaging, attractive, and story-rich content, Reporting into the Head of Content, the Social Content Producer is responsible for creating engaging, original, and wellbeing-obsessed content to life that is on-brand, platform-ready, and sets Healf’s socials apart. As a key player in bringing content to life, the Social Content Producer will collaborate with wider comms and partnership teams to bring a range of concepts to life.

What You Will Do:

  • Ideate, capture, and edit social-first content including short-form video, photography, motion graphics, and static assets for owned social channels, primarily Instagram.

  • Optimise content for saves, shares, and reach, constantly pushing for creative assets that drive engagement.

  • Drive ownable formats forward, working with talent to create unmistakably Healf series.

  • Edit final assets using Final Cut Pro, Adobe Photoshop, Premiere Pro, and other tools within the Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Bring Healf’s product curation to life in creative, social formats that go beyond aesthetic UGC.

  • Interpret creative briefs and brand guidelines to produce content that is visually consistent and strategically aligned.

  • Contribute to the overall social media strategy and help shape it through original, scroll-stopping ideas.

  • Assist in pre-production planning, specifically shot list development.

  • Support in managing content calendars, asset libraries, and production logistics.

  • Stay on the pulse of social media trends, emerging formats, and platform algorithm changes to inform content strategy.

  • Work closely with brand and talent partners to bring a range of content to life, including product-first concepts and talent campaigns.

  • Stay in the know of wellbeing trends, brand innovation, and cultural moments.

  • Actively contribute creative ideas in brainstorms and concept development sessions.

  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, meeting deadlines without compromising quality.

  • Work with influencers, content partners, and other talent to bring social-first concepts to life.

  • Support paid social by adapting and repurposing top-performing organic content into ad-ready formats.

  • Collaborate with the paid social/performance team to ensure creative learnings and platform trends inform both the organic and paid content pipelines.

What You Will Bring:

  • 4+ years of experience in social content production, digital media, or a related creative role.

  • Proficient in Final Cut Pro and Adobe Photoshop; strong command of Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, and Lightroom.

  • Deep understanding of social content best practices and what makes content successful across specific platforms.

  • Proven ability to translate strategic briefs into premium, on-brand visual content.

  • Strong visual storytelling sensibility and a keen eye for design, motion, and editorial quality.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  • Comfortable presenting ideas to cross-functional teams.

  • Strong project management instincts with the ability to prioritise across multiple workstreams.

  • The ability to translate the brand’s tone of voice, mission, and visual identity through original social concepts.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Putting Healf in front of new audiences through bold, innovative, and culturally resonant ideas that interrupt mindless scrolling.

  • Consistent contribution to weekly content performance, tracked against reach, saves, shares, and comments across organic social.

  • Delivery of content within agreed timelines and briefs, supporting a repeatable production cadence.

  • Growth in content quality and originality, reflected in improved all-time performance ranking over time.

  • Creating organic content that transitions seamlessly into paid use.

  • Elevate Healf as the leading wellbeing brand, owning the intersection of wellbeing and culture, while maintaining a consistent social voice.

The Deal

We ask a great deal of the people who work here. We expect full ownership and a genuine commitment to give this chapter everything you have.

In return, we will give you the same: everything we have, invested in your growth, your wellbeing, and the defining skills of the next decade.

We have built the fastest-growing company in Europe with a team small enough that every person in it shapes the outcome. That is still true today. The next person we hire will change the trajectory of the company.

If the most important work of your career is ahead of you, this is the place to do it.

jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Identity and Access Management team. Owning DeepL's full identity stack: organisation, account and session management, SSO federation, SCIM provisioning, and the OIDC provider, for both internal and external users. It is the foundation every DeepL product relies on to authenticate and authorise users securely and at scale. When identity is unavailable, no one can log in, so reliability and performance sit at the heart of everything the team does.

We are shifting gears from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to simply maintain legacy endpoints or close Jira tickets. We hire Missionaries — builders who obsess over the Why before the How. You will contribute across the stack, shipping features that create delightful, frictionless experiences for both external developers and internal engineering teams.

Your responsibilities

  • Own the Identity Experience End-to-End: You will architect and build complex, user-facing features across our identity stack. You will own business-critical systems from the initial problem definition through to architectural design, deployment, and production reliability. You measure success by user impact, not just pull requests merged

  • Build for "Consumer-Grade" Enterprise: You understand that authentication and authorization systems cannot fail. You build for reliability and maintainability, while delivering a user-friendly experience. You will lead incident response, and continuously raise the bar on code quality and operational health

  • Collaborate to Raise the Bar: You will work closely with teammates across Identity and adjacent teams - other product teams, Product Management and Support. You will lead designs, scoping, shaping, and solving hard product and technical challenges in collaboration with your team and other engineers

  • Drive Technical Pragmatism: Whether using our core stack (C#/.NET Core, Kubernetes, Postgres) or exploring new tools, you choose the technology that solves the customer problem most effectively, ensuring long-term maintainability over short-term trends. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving

Qualities we look for

  • Extreme Ownership & Operational Excellence: You own your services end-to-end (production operations, incident response, and on-call) and you're motivated by pushing reliability toward four nines. You write comprehensive tests, monitor the systems in production, and you treat each incident as an opportunity to learn

  • A "System Thinker" Mindset: You don't just know syntax; you understand failure modes, system boundaries, and how your code impacts the broader architecture at scale. You can design systems that deliver high availability for our millions of users.

  • Backend Mastery at Scale (C# / .NET): You have deep expertise designing scalable backend systems and distributed architectures, and you've worked with high-scale distributed systems in production. Strong system design is core to how you work. Roughly 80-90% of the work is backend; working on the frontend (React/Javascript) is a welcome plus, not a requirement

  • Enterprise Domain Curiosity: You are interested in the hard problems of B2B SaaS Identity - authentication (SSO/OIDC), authorization, and requirements such as security and auditing. You understand that these aren't "boring details"; they are the pillars of trust for enterprise clients

  • AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving

A Note on Our Hiring Process: DeepL hires for the Company, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack.

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares: An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

 

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

Stellenbeschreibung

Du siehst einen Trend und denkst nicht: „Das könnten wir auch machen.“

Was kommt danach? Was passt zu unserer Kundin? Und wie machen wir daraus etwas, das eindeutig Pammys ist?

Du hast ein außergewöhnliches Gespür für Schuhe, Fashion, Farben, Materialien und Silhouetten und gleichzeitig genug kommerzielles Verständnis, um zu wissen, dass ein großartiges Produkt nicht nur auf einem Moodboard funktionieren muss.

Es muss gekauft werden.

  • Tiefes Verständnis aktueller Footwear-, Fashion-, Lifestyle- und Consumer-Trends

  • Sehr gutes Verständnis des gesamten Footwear-Entwicklungsprozesses von Design über Sampling bis zur Produktion
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop und relevanten Design-Tools, Erfahrung mit 3D- und AI-basierten Design-Workflows ist ein großes Plus
  • Starkes kommerzielles Verständnis und die Fähigkeit, Kreativität, Customer Needs und Verkaufspotenzial miteinander zu verbinden
  • Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit Product Development, Fabriken und internationalen Produktionspartnern
  • Sehr hohe visuelle Standards und gleichzeitig Geschwindigkeit in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung
  • Ausgeprägte Eigeninitiative und eine klare kreative Meinung
  • Hohe internationale Reisebereitschaft für Trend Research, Messen, Lieferanten und Produktionspartner
  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse, Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil


Deine Vorteile bei Pammys

jobs.title: Junior Automation Specialist
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Junior Automation Specialist

About the Role

Customer Care at Perk is being rebuilt around automation and AI. This role is for someone who likes taking a messy operational problem and turning it into something that runs in production.

As an Automation Specialist, you'll design and ship the systems that cut manual work, make agents faster, and improve what customers actually experience. You'll work across Make.com, Airtable, Zendesk, Claude, APIs, and whatever else the problem needs. Some days that's a workflow. Some days it's an AI tool with evals, guardrails, and a kill switch. The through-line is the same: get it from idea to live, then keep it reliable.

You'll partner with Operational Excellence, Customer Care Leadership, and Operations. You'll own delivery end to end, and you'll be measured on whether the things you build actually stick.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, test, and deploy solutions across Make.com, Airtable, Zendesk, Claude, APIs, and AI tooling.

  • Wire up multi-system integrations that remove real manual effort, not just move it around.

  • Own projects from the first sketch through production and ongoing improvement.

  • Stand up proper testing and validation environments so "it worked in my scenario" isn't the bar.

  • Turn business problems into technical designs, and flag new automation opportunities as you go.

  • Stay close after launch: watch adoption, fix what breaks, iterate on what underperforms

Build

  • Write automations that are maintainable, documented, and safe for someone else to pick up.

  • Monitor production systems, debug fast, and keep operational impact low when things go wrong.

  • Know when Make/Zapier-class tools are enough, and when the problem needs a different approach.

  • Keep an eye on new automation and AI capabilities, and bring the useful ones in deliberately.

Raise the bar

  • Be the person others ask when they're stuck on architecture, platform limits, or how to ship AI safely.

  • Review builds before they go live when that review actually reduces risk..

  • Create reusable components, patterns, and standards so the next build is faster and cleaner.

Teamwork

  • Sit with Opex and Operations until you understand the real problem, then design the right fix.

  • Shape discovery and scoping so solutions stay practical and maintainable.

  • Keep stakeholders clear on progress, risks, dependencies, and dates.

  • Feed operational feedback back into the next version.

What We're Looking For

  • Shipped production automations on Make.com, Zapier, Claude, or similar not just demos.

  • Worked with Airtable or comparable systems as a real ops backbone, not a side spreadsheet.

  • Built LLM-powered workflows with prompt craft, evaluation, and guardrails — and knows when the model shouldn't act alone.

  • Strong at debugging production systems under time pressure.

  • Can turn a fuzzy business request into something scalable and supportable.

  • Comfortable working with both technical and operational partners.

  • Prefers speed and ambiguity over perfect specs.

How We'll Know You're Winning

  • Automations that meaningfully cut manual work in Customer Care.

  • Multi-system builds that stay reliable once they're live.

  • High reliability, performance, and adoption — not just "launched".

  • Clear gains in operational efficiency, agent experience, and customer experience.

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

Interview Process

Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual
Hiring Manager interview - 30-45mins Virtual
Assessment Interview - 30-60mins - In-person interview

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Are you passionate about designing scalable data platforms and helping others grow along the way? As a Senior Data Engineer, you will shape the architecture and technical direction of our Google Cloud data platform while enabling a team of engineers to deliver reliable, high-quality data products.

Working closely with the Head of Data Platform, product teams, data scientists, analysts, and engineers across DISH and METRO, you will build the foundation for data-driven decision-making across the business. This is a highly influential role combining hands-on engineering, architectural leadership, mentoring, and continuous improvement.


Menu of Responsibilities

  • Define and evolve the architecture, standards, and roadmap of our Google Cloud data platform, ensuring alignment with business goals and long-term scalability.
  • Design and deliver reliable, high-performance data pipelines and data products using modern cloud-native tools and engineering practices.
  • Establish data quality, governance, testing, monitoring, and operational excellence practices that enable trusted analytics and machine learning outcomes.
  • Mentor engineers across different experience levels through coaching, code reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing.
  • Lead the resolution of complex technical challenges, production incidents, and cross-functional initiatives while fostering collaboration and shared ownership.
  • Drive the adoption of modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted development, with clear quality, security, and reliability guardrails.


Ingredients for Success

  • Proven expertise in designing and operating scalable data platforms and distributed data systems in a cloud environment.
  • Deep knowledge of data architecture, data modeling, and modern warehouse or lakehouse approaches, with strong Python and SQL skills.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform services such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, and related technologies.
  • Strong experience building data orchestration, transformation, and testing solutions using tools such as Airflow and dbt.
  • Demonstrated ability to define technical direction, influence architectural decisions, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborative leadership style with a passion for mentoring others, driving continuous improvement, and balancing innovation with operational excellence.


Recipe Card

DISH has more than 380k customers across multiple countries, with a diverse team representing over 34 nationalities. Our products range from reservation solutions to payment terminals, providing a broad toolkit to independent, small to medium-sized restaurants to digitize their businesses. While we are approximately 200 employees at DISH, we closely collaborate with METRO and their countries to transform the HoReCa sector with our innovative solutions, making us a leader in this industry.


Join our HoReCa Revolution

We are building the data foundation for the future of hospitality. If you are excited about cloud-native data platforms, scalable engineering solutions, and empowering teams to do their best work, we would love to hear from you. Join us in shaping the next generation of data capabilities for DISH and transforming the future of the HoReCa industry.


Be one part of many chefs

GET THINGS DONE QUICKLY 
Join our fast-paced environment where we push boundaries and actively challenge ourselves to digitise the HoReCa (Hotel, Restaurant, and Catering) world. By joining DISH, you will directly contribute to our goal of becoming a data-driven company within the METRO Growth Plan. 

OWNERSHIP 
At DISH, you own your projects, regardless of your job level. We encourage you to stand up for your ideas, think outside the box, and always question the status quo. Your unique perspective can make all the difference! 

FLEXWORK
We know that life happens and we cater your needs to integrate work from where you work most productive – also up to 30 days working from abroad of Germany in specific countries. 
  
INNOVATION & AGILE WORK 
We understand the value of learning from mistakes and know that every setback is an opportunity for growth and improvement. In our agile working culture we learn from each other and embrace an entrepreneurial mindset. 

DISHVERSITY 
Join an international company with members from over 34 different cultures.  
Together, we celebrate diversity and respect our multinational backgrounds. 

DISHPOWERMENT 
Our commitment extends beyond business success - we want our employees to thrive! We have got loads of opportunities for skill-building and career development. You are never alone, we have got your back! Whether it is your manager, your team, or colleagues from other departments, they are all here to empower you! 

CUSTOMER CENTRICITY 
Understanding our customer is essential. We are experts in the market and are passionate about creating digital solutions for our customers to truly live their passion. As part of #OneMETRO we run together and sCore together; wholesale to the max!

You will support our clients in the digital and organizational evolution of their business models and processes - from strategy development through to operational implementation.
You will work at the intersection of business, technology, and change management, applying agile methodologies in a targeted and effective way. In transformation projects, you will play a central role by bringing structure, clarity, and strong execution capabilities.

Your responsibilities will include a wide range of tasks:

  • Supporting transformation initiatives: Assisting clients in the structured development and optimization of organizations, processes, and ways of working
  • Interface management between business and IT: Gathering, structuring, and aligning business requirements while ensuring a shared understanding of project objectives

  • A completed degree in (Business) Informatics, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field of study

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer (m/f/d) - focus on iOS
jobs.description:
YOUR TEAM

We are seeking a Junior Software Engineer with focus on iOS to join our team to further develop the modern ottonova software ecosystem. At ottonova, we value teamwork, technical excellence, delivering value, positivity, constant improvement, growth and innovation. You will be part of one of our five software engineering teams, which offers a great way to learn from experienced Software Engineers and advance in your professional career.
In addition, you will have the opportunity to participate in our Mobile and Architecture Chapters, where experience is shared among all Software Engineers in the company. This will enable you to learn and grow as an Engineer at an accelerated pace.
 
As a Junior iOS Engineer you work with a cross-functional team to build features in ottonova's iOS app. You work closely with our product manager, other mobile native engineers, designers as well as backend developers and actively help shape the future of our products. The team is based in Munich and works in a hybrid setup.


YOUR IMPACT

  • Enhancing existing features and developing new features: Work with other developers to help further develop our iOS app
  • Drive development: Contribute to building new features while ensuring the codebase remains reliable, maintainable, and high performing
  • Owning your code: Take responsibility for testing your work, including writing automated UI test frameworks (XCUITest/XCTest) 
  • Documenting and reviewing: Participate in code reviews and document your work to ensure knowledge sharing, continuous learning and maintainable solutions
  • Share your ideas: Bring creativity and problem-solving skills to the table, helping us redefine how people perceive health insurance


YOUR SKILLSET

Being in a Junior role at ottonova is all about learning and taking the next step. We are committed to supporting your growth in an interesting and challenging environment. Along with a positive work ethic and manner and a willingness to learn and develop both personally and professionally, you will bring the following to the table:  

  • You are interested in producing high-quality software: testing, code reviews and clean coding practices 
  • You are able to clearly express and discuss technical concepts and write technical documentation
  • You have a proficient level of written and spoken English as well as clear and effective communication skills 
  • You have a good understanding of your personal toolset: your OS, Xcode, debugging tools and AI assisted development
  • You enjoy great mobile UX and working closely with designers
  • You complement your profile with basic knowledge of:
    • Swift
    • Building UI on iOS (UIKit and/or SwiftUI)
    • Concurrency basics (async/await, main-thread safety)
    • Knowledge about reactive programming (RxSwift)
    • Version control (Git)
    • Unit testing

Advantages.
Not a requirement, but a plus would be the following aspects:
  • A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience with RxSwift
  • Experience with Memory management
  • Familiarity with architecture patterns (e.g. MVVM)
  • Experience consuming REST APIs
  • Knowledge about Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP)

jobs.title: Senior Quantum Fault-Tolerance Architect (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Our approach combines laser schemes for cooling/initialization/readout, engineered magnetic-field gradient induced coupling (MAGIC) combined with microwave control for universal gate sets, and advanced quantum control techniques and dedicated firmware to work within the high-fidelity regime and below the error threshold of quantum error correction (QEC).


A central objective of our technology roadmap is the realization of fault-tolerant quantum computing. To achieve this goal, we combine the above high-fidelity quantum hardware with microscopic physics-based modelling, hardware–software co-design, advanced characterization and benchmarking techniques, and detailed numerical simulations to model system performance realistically and identify the optimal QEC strategy and the associated system requirements.

As part of our initiative towards fault-tolerant quantum computing, we are expanding our Foundations & Concepts team and are looking for a Senior Quantum Fault-Tolerance Architect (f/m/d) to help establish and grow this strategic activity within the company.


Role Overview:

As Senior Quantum Fault-Tolerance Architect (f/m/d), you will help shaping eleQtron’s long-term roadmap towards logical quantum computing, driving research activities in quantum error correction and fault tolerance, contributing to key architectural decisions, coordinating cross-functional efforts across hardware, software, system architecture and applications, and playing a leading role in building and growing the company’s fault-tolerance capability.


Responsibilities: 

  • Develop and drive fault-tolerant quantum-computing strategies and logical architectures for trapped-ion MAGIC quantum processors.

  • Lead hardware-aware quantum error-correction studies and guide architectural decisions for future processor generations.

  • Coordinate realistic performance models connecting hardware characterization, circuit-level noise models, and logical performance metrics.

  • Work closely with System Architecture, System Operations, Software Engineering, and Quantum Applications teams to support the co-design of future fault-tolerant quantum computers.

  • Contribute to the development and mentoring of a growing fault-tolerance team while supporting eleQtron’s long-term technology roadmap.


Required Skills:

  • PhD in Physics, Quantum Information and Computation, or a closely related field.

  • Exceptional postdoctoral or industrial research experience in quantum error correction and, ideally, logical architecture design.

  • Demonstrated scientific leadership and the ability to drive independent research activities.

  • Ability to work effectively across theory, hardware, software, and engineering disciplines.

  • Fluent communication in English 

What you can expect from eleQtron: 

  • Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remunerations that reflect this, additionally rewarding achievements. 

  • Flexible working hours: We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules. 

  • Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the game.

Join our robotics team to develop next-generation perception and multi-object tracking systems capable of operating reliably in complex, dynamic, GPS-denied environments. 
As our technical expert for Multi-Object Tracking and state estimation, you will drive the evolution of our perception stack, from architecture and algorithm design to deployment on real robotic platforms. Working closely with autonomy, controls and middleware engineers, you will participate to technical decisions, establish best practices and continuously improve the robustness and performance of our perception capabilities. 
This is a highly hands-on robotics position focused on delivering production-ready software that performs reliably in the field, not research prototypes.

  • Own the development of intrinsic and extrinsic calibration pipelines for complex sensor configurations, including zooming camera systems.

  • Work closely with autonomy, controls and middleware teams to ensure seamless end-to-end system integration. 
  • Mentor and support other engineers through technical discussions, architecture reviews and code reviews. 
  • Develop and validate perception algorithms in simulation before deployment on embedded robotic platforms. 
  • Optimize algorithms for real-time execution on embedded GPU platforms. 
  • Lead debugging and validation during field testing, analyze failures and continuously improve system robustness. 


Your profile

We are looking for an experienced robotics engineer who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to drive an entire technical domain from concept to deployment. 

Must-have 

  • Strong C++ and Python development skills. 
  • Extensive experience with ROS/ROS2. 
  • Strong background in robotics perception, computer vision and state estimation. 
  • Proven experience developing and deploying production-grade robotics software. 
  • Excellent mathematical foundations in estimation, optimization and probabilistic methods. 
  • Proven ability to independently drive complex technical workstreams. 
  • Experience deploying and debugging software on real robotic platforms. 
  • Ability to influence technical decisions and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

Strong advantages

jobs.title: Senior FP&A Analyst (all genders)
jobs.description:
About us

At GotPhoto, we are freeing photographers to be more successful.

Through our platforms GotPhoto.com and fotograf.de, we help professional photographers simplify and transform the way they work — from photo management and client communication to ordering and payment processing. Our end-to-end workflow and e-commerce solution gives photographers more time to focus on what matters most: being behind the lens.

Since 2012, we’ve built a sustainable and profitable business driven by entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a deep understanding of photographers’ everyday challenges. Today, thousands of photographers trust our software , creating their own success stories along the way.

As the leading e-commerce engine for professional volume photographers and a business backed by EQT, one of the world’s leading private equity firms, we’re powered by a team of 150+ talented and international people building technology that simplifies photographers’ everyday work and helps them focus on capturing meaningful moments.

Join us on our journey to empower photographers like never before.

Your Role

Do you want to move beyond traditional Excel modeling and define the future of data-driven finance operations?

Are you ready to be a key architect of the financial narrative for a high-growth SaaS business backed by world-class PE investors?

...then you are our perfect match!

Prepare for a steep learning curve and the opportunity to leave a lasting legacy by evolving our FP&A infrastructure for the next stage of scale. This is not a 'run the model and report back' role; we want someone who interrogates the numbers, surfaces the story behind them, and is willing to challenge assumptions at every level of the organisation.

Please note: This is a 12 month maternity cover.

What You'll Do

  • Drive Strategic Visibility: Build, maintain, and present meaningful dashboards and reports (e.g., Monthly Flash, Management Pack, Board Pack) that enable the Board, CFO, and Head of FP&A to monitor performance and take action.

  • Modernize the Stack: Support the migration of our FP&A tool/platform by defining requirements, mapping data flows, validating systems, and training stakeholders.

  • Architect Planning Frameworks: Implement end-to-end forecasting and budgeting templates and processes to enable efficient, accurate quarterly and annual planning cycles.

  • Define the Truth: Partner with the Data team to validate SaaS KPIs, ensuring a single version of truth across all business reporting.

  • Sales & Marketing Partnering: Support pipeline-to-forecast conversion modeling and commission tracking for Sales, while collaborating with Marketing to optimize segment profitability and ROI.

  • Operational Ownership: Manage and forecast global OPEX directly with department heads and support the Accounting team with month-end reviews and ad-hoc strategic business cases.

What You'll Bring

Experience

  • The Foundation: Minimum 4+ years’ experience in FP&A, business finance, or a similar analytical role, ideally within a high-growth SaaS or subscription business.

  • The "Scar Tissue": Proven track record of building complex financial models and managing investor-grade reporting (Private Equity/PE experience is a significant plus).

  • The Builder: Experience with platform/tool migrations (FP&A or ERP systems) and a history of driving process improvements.

Skills

  • Technical Mastery: Highly proficient in Excel/G-Sheets; SQL experience is a plus.

  • AI & Automation: Proven track record of leveraging AI-driven tools and methodologies to streamline analytical workflows and optimize repetitive tasks.

  • SaaS Fluency: Deep understanding of SaaS economics and metrics (ARR, Churn, LTV/CAC).

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written English; German is a bonus but not required.

Mindset

  • The Interrogator: You don't just report numbers; you surface the story behind them and challenge assumptions at every level.

  • The Owner Mindset: You take full ownership of your workstreams and drive change in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

  • Bias to Action: You prefer a "shipped" automated solution over a "perfect" manual one.

  • Keep it Simple: You champion the value of simplicity, identifying process improvements and eliminating non-value-added tasks.

Why You’ll Love Life at GotPhoto

  • Best of Both Worlds: We live and breathe a flexible hybrid model. Our beautiful office at Hausvogteiplatz is our vibrant Berlin hub for collaboration, but you have the freedom to leverage the setup that works best for you.

  • Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We believe in flexibility that respects your lifestyle. Once you have completed your probation, you have the option to work remotely from within Europe for up to 40 days per year. Whether you are visiting family or simply seeking a change of scenery, we support a work-from-anywhere culture that helps you stay inspired.

  • Recharge & Unwind: We value your downtime. You start with 26 days of leave, plus we love to top that up with additional discretionary "X-days" to make sure you’re truly rested.

  • Multicultural & Inclusive Team: We thrive on diverse perspectives. Our international team fosters a culture of mutual respect and professional exchange, ensuring that fresh ideas and tolerance are at the heart of everything we build together.

  • Fuel Your Growth: We’re big on learning. You’ll get a dedicated education budget to explore new ideas and grow professionally.

  • Exclusive Employee Discounts: Get more for your money with access to the "Benefits at Work" platform, offering significant discounts on top global brands.

  • Your Benefits, Your Choice: Through Probonio, you get a monthly budget to spend on what matters to you—whether that’s your public transport pass or other flexible perks that fit your lifestyle.

 

What Matters to Us

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds may refrain from applying for positions if they feel they don't meet all qualifications. We strongly encourage you to apply if you’re interested: we're excited to discover how your distinctive experience can enhance our team!

We work as one team. Wherever you come from. However, you identify. We believe in equal opportunities.

This is a pure new business role. You own a defined territory and named-account set, the pipeline you create within it, and the commercial outcome of every deal you run, from first conversation to signature.

Land and Expand

  • First wins scoped so they can grow: sites, countries and use cases sequenced from the start.

  • A clean handover to Customer Success, with the expansion path documented.

Forecasting and Governance

  • A forecast that holds, with stage integrity, next steps and close dates you stand behind.

  • Contribution to the playbook i.e. objections, competitive intelligence and repeatable use cases.

Commercial outcomes

  • Pipeline creation and territory coverage

  • Win rate, against incumbents and against no decision

  • Average deal value and total multi-year value

  • Strategic logos won

Operating standards

  • Forecast accuracy and stage integrity

  • Multi-threading and MEDDICC quality

  • Price protection and discount discipline

  • CRM quality and process discipline

Your First 12 Months

  • First 90 days: complete onboarding, build the territory and account plan, establish pipeline coverage and create the first qualified opportunities.

Package, Support and Progression

This role is for an accomplished new business seller who wants the autonomy to build a territory, the support to win complex enterprise deals and real reward for over-performance. If you have created pipeline, won meaningful customers and run a disciplined process, we would like to hear from you.
