jobs.title: Senior Endpoint Engineer
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We're looking for a Sr Endpoint Engineer who's excited about consolidating and updating legacy systems with an eye for automation. You'll be responsible for the MDM platforms, endpoint policies, device deployment pipelines, and fleet tooling that underpin how every employee at Wave interacts with their device. This role blends architectural ownership with hands-on execution, requiring you to deliver scalable, resilient, and compliant endpoint solutions in a fast growth environment.

You'll own the endpoint function end-to-end: platform and policy design, provisioning standards, fleet reporting, and security integration. You'll work closely with Information Security, IT, and People Operations, and you'll be the person who sets the technical direction for how Wave manages devices at scale. The first year will be weighted toward remediation and foundation-building before shifting toward automation and scale. Candidates who have built in scrappy, high-complexity environments will be better prepared for this role than those who have only operated mature platforms in static environments.

In this role, you'll: 

  • Own and operate Wave's MDM platforms across ChromeOS (GWS Admin Console), macOS (Jamf), Android, (and Linux environments): configuration, policy design, maintenance, and roadmap.
    • Manage ChromeOS device policy in Google Workspace: enrollment configuration, org unit structure, security policies, extension management, and OS version enforcement across the majority of the fleet.
  • Design and enforce endpoint security policies in collaboration with Information Security, including EDR integration (CrowdStrike Falcon), compliance baselines, and patch management.
  • Build and maintain automated deployment pipelines for OS updates, software distribution, and configuration changes: minimizing manual intervention and maximizing consistency. 
  • Define and manage the device lifecycle: provisioning standards, imaging, refresh cycles, decommission processes, and fleet reporting.
  • Establish cross-platform compatibility standards and tooling for a heterogeneous fleet (macOS, Linux, Android, with awareness of ChromeOS and Windows edge cases).
  • Build the tooling and runbooks that Local IT teams use to execute provisioning and onboarding on the ground. You set the standard, they execute it.
  • Own fleet observability: dashboards, compliance reporting, patch currency metrics, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Evaluate and own vendor relationships for endpoint tooling, including MDM, patch management, and related platforms.
  • Mentor junior profiles working in endpoint and device management.

Key Details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA, Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso. Wherever you are based, you must have reliable Internet access and have work authorization.
  • Wave covers travel once per year to one of our operating countries in Africa, as well as a yearly stipend of $1,200 to meet with coworkers.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your experience level and location, we are offering a salary range of $96,500 to $133,100 USD (paid in your local currency equivalent) plus a generous equity package.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country)
    • 6 months fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance
    • Unlimited vacation with a 20-day minimum requirement
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching

Requirements

  • BA in Computer Science, Economics, Data Analytics, or equivalent experience in the required field.
  • 5+ years in endpoint engineering or systems engineering with hands-on ownership of multi-platform fleets at scale.
  • Demonstrated strong understanding of two out of the following:
    • ChromeOS fleet management via Google Workspace Admin Console (device policy, org unit design, forced installs, Context-Aware Access).
    • Deep macOS expertise: Jamf administration, macOS internals, configuration profiles, extension attributes, scripting (Bash, Python, or Swift).
    • Android MDM experience: enterprise enrollment, policy enforcement, and management via Android Enterprise (EMM/MDM platforms)
    • Linux endpoint management experience: package management, configuration tooling (Ansible, Chef, Puppet, or similar), and hardening
  • Windows/Intune experience is not required, but can be considered applicable if enough strength in our existing device fleet is demonstrated.
  • Strong understanding of endpoint security principles: EDR integration, compliance baselines (CIS, SOC2), certificate management, and disk encryption enforcement.
  • Familiarity with identity and access tooling as it touches endpoints:  SSO, certificate-based auth, conditional access policies (Okta or equivalent).
  • Scripting and automation capability sufficient to build reliable deployment pipelines and reduce manual operational work.
  • Fleet reporting and observability, meaning you can tell leadership the compliance posture of the fleet at any time.

You might be a good fit if you 

  • You've owned an endpoint function through a period of growth or organizational change, not just maintained a stable one.
  • You build for the people executing on the ground. Your runbooks actually work, your tooling has sensible defaults, and your policies account for the reality of field operations.
  • You can communicate risk and tradeoffs clearly to InfoSec, IT leadership, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You're comfortable operating with ambiguity and incomplete inventory data, and your first instinct is to establish observability, not assume things are fine.
  • You have experience with CrowdStrike Falcon or equivalent EDR platforms
  • Prior work in a fintech or regulated industry with compliance-driven endpoint requirements
  • Have French language skills or an interest in learning French
  • Experience managing device fleets in multi-country markets, ideally including emerging market contexts.

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Solution Architect (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your creative field

We are looking for two full-time, permanent Solution Architects to start as soon as possible. We're filling this role at two levels. See below where you recognise yourself. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations.


You open your laptop in the morning and know that today will probably be different from what you planned. Maybe you're in a refinement session and realise halfway through that the proposed solution won't hold up at scale. Maybe a developer asks a question that makes you rethink a concept you thought was finished last week. Some days are structured, some aren't – but you know how to work with both.

This isn't a greenfield. At Contabo Group, two systems run in parallel: a PHP monolith with 15 years in production, grown across multiple teams and generations of decisions and a younger microservice system with a message broker built over the last few years. Together they serve more than 250,000 customers worldwide. You know that a landscape like this has its own logic and that you don't redraw it from scratch, but take the time to understand it before you start changing it.

Your job is to develop this landscape further. That means retiring legacy systems where it makes sense, keeping the architecture clean even when there's business pressure to cut corners, and bringing teams along rather than issuing mandates. You own the solution architecture across software, infrastructure and networking – and you make sure decisions are made transparently, not in a vacuum. If you naturally share what you know, not because it's in the job description but because you understand that bad architecture eventually hits everyone – then this is likely the right place for you. 


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:  

Must have:
• Architectural knowledge for complex, distributed systems 
• Solid understanding of the hosting domain – you know what happens behind a VPS booking 
• Systems modelling with UML, C4, BPMN, ERD, or FMC (e.g. Drawio, Visio, Mermaid) 
• 5+ years of experience, with 2+ years focused on architecture 
• Fluent in German and English 
 
Should have: 
• Experience with Kubernetes, Ansible, or comparable IaC tools 
• Some or deep experience migrating monolithic systems to microservices 
• Mentoring background 
 
Nice to have: 
• AI tools in everyday development (e.g. Claude Code) 
 
We're filling this role at two levels. See where you recognise yourself: 
 
Senior - You own the full architecture responsibility and set the standard for all teams. 

  • 7+ years of experience, 2+ in the industry
  • Full ownership of architecture & governance
  • You define processes and drive them with the team
  • Deepexpertisein scaling, resilience, and redundancy
  • Proactive mentoring of all engineers

Mid-Level - You grow into architectural responsibility – with real scope and clear support. 
  • 5+ years of experience, 2+ years with architecture focus
  • Co-design solution architecture with senior support
  • Gradually take on governance responsibilities
  • Interest in mentoring and knowledge sharing
  • Openness to learningnew technologies
 
We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference. 


Awesome Prospects

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.
What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint. 

Additionally, we offer: 

  • Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office
  • Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
  • Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities
  • Enjoy exclusiveperks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program
  • Recharge your energy – 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve
  • Give back – An extra day off to get involved in social activities through our Volunteer Day
  • Make an impact – Take ownership and bring your ideas to life with real creative freedom
  • Keep growing – Individual professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative tech environment
  • Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations
  • Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity
  • Create lasting memories – Company events and team activities you won’t forget


How to reach us

If you have any questions you can reach Alina by phone at +49 (0) 89 244 106 7714.

jobs.title: (Senior) Customer Success Manager (alle Geschlechter)
jobs.description:
Deine High-Speed Mission

Zu Speed Kit

Speed Kit macht die Shops und Websites unserer Kunden messbar schneller, und schnellere Seiten heißen mehr Umsatz. Zu unseren Kunden gehören einige der bekanntesten E-Commerce-Marken in Deutschland und Europa.

Zu deiner Rolle

Customer Success bei uns ist deshalb keine Zufriedenheitsverwaltung, sondern die Verantwortung dafür, dass ein Kunde live geht, den Effekt auf sein Geschäft nachvollziehen kann und langfristig bleibt. Die initiale Unterschrift holen unsere Account Executives. Danach sitzt du im Driver Seat: Du bringst den Kunden durch Trial oder POC über die Ziellinie und behältst ihn anschließend in deinem Portfolio. Der Kunde bleibt deiner, mit allem was dazugehört.

Was du verantwortest

  • Du führst Trials und POCs deiner Neukunden: Du steuerst Integration und Konfiguration mit unserem Team und dem Kunden, koordinierst A/B-Test-Setup und Auswertung und hältst die Stakeholder zusammen. Du erkennst früh, wenn ein Projekt kippt, und drehst es. 

  • Du führst die Onboarding-Projekte als echte Projektleitung, von Kickoff über Go-live bis zur Ergebnispräsentation. Das ist der Schwerpunkt der Rolle.

  • Du betreust deine Bestandskunden aus eigenem Antrieb. Du gehst auf deine Accounts zu, bevor sie sich melden, kennst ihre Roadmap und ihre Relaunches und bringst regelmäßig Ergebnisse und Ideen an den Tisch.

  • Du trägst Umsatzverantwortung für dein Portfolio: Verlängerungen, Commitment-Upgrades, Überschreitungen, Ausbau in weitere Domains, Marken und Länder. Du weißt jederzeit, wo dein Book steht und warum. Und weil dein Erfolg unser Erfolg ist, profitierst du auch entsprechend davon.

  • Du führst Kundengespräche auf Basis von Daten: Core Web Vitals, CrUX, Conversion-Uplift, ROI. Du kannst einen Uplift erklären und auch eine Verschlechterung, ohne auszuweichen.

  • Du arbeitest täglich mit AI. Analysen, Reporting, Datenrecherche über unsere Systeme, Entwürfe für Kundenkommunikation: das machst du mit Claude und Gemini und baust dir eigene wiederverwendbare Workflows dafür. Wir erwarten kein Coding, aber wir erwarten, dass du dir selbst Hebel baust, statt Dinge manuell abzuarbeiten.

  • Du bist die Spinne im Netz. Niemand im Unternehmen weiß so viel über unsere Kunden wie du, und du bringst dieses Wissen in alle Teams, von Engineering und Product über Sales bis zur Geschäftsführung.


Wie es bei uns wirklich läuft

Das Customer Success Team ist eine kleine, extrem eingespielte Truppe und liefert unseren Kunden echten, messbaren Mehrwert. Das ist eine High-Impact-Rolle: Was du bewegst, ist sofort sichtbar, im Ergebnis des Kunden und in unseren Zahlen. Dazu extrem flache Hierarchien, kein Freigabetheater, direkte Gespräche mit Engineering, Product und Geschäftsführung. Was du entscheidest, gilt. Dafür brauchst du aber auch eine eigene Meinung und den Mut, sie auszusprechen. Wenn du etwas anders siehst, sagst du es, und du bleibst dabei, auch wenn jemand widerspricht.

Wir haben mehr Projekte als Hände. Ein Teil deiner Woche wird von außen bestimmt, deshalb ist gute Triage entscheidend: Du erkennst, welches der zehn offenen Themen heute Umsatz bewegt oder einen Kunden hält, und was warten kann. Du bekommst von uns Ziele, Kontext und Rückendeckung, aber niemand sortiert deine Prioritäten für dich. Dazu gehört auch, dass du den Mund aufmachst, wenn es brennt: nicht bei jeder Unsicherheit, sondern nachdem du selbst ernsthaft versucht hast, das Problem zu lösen. Keine Probleme, die drei Wochen im Stillen wachsen, und keine Eskalation für jede Frage, die du selbst beantworten könntest.


Dein Ticket für unser Raumschiff

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Customer Success oder Account Management im B2B SaaS

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung technischer Onboarding-, Trial- oder Implementierungsprojekte mit mehreren Stakeholdern auf Kundenseite

  • Erfahrung mit oder klare Bereitschaft zu echter Umsatzverantwortung. Du willst, dass dein Ergebnis an Kundenerfolg hängt, statt es zu vermeiden.

  • AI-Tools als tägliches Arbeitsmittel. Das ist harte Voraussetzung und kein Pluspunkt. Wir werden dich im Bewerbungsprozess bitten, konkret zu zeigen, was du mit Claude, Gemini oder vergleichbaren Tools gebaut oder automatisiert hast. "Ich nutze ChatGPT manchmal für E-Mails" reicht dafür nicht.

  • Selbstbewusstsein und Standing. Du trittst gegenüber Entscheidern auf Augenhöhe auf, führst auch unangenehme Gespräche über Preise, Verzögerungen und Erwartungen, und widersprichst einem Kunden freundlich, wenn er falsch liegt.

  • Digitale Tools sind für dich selbstverständlich. Ein neues System bringst du dir selbst bei, statt auf eine Schulung zu warten.

  • Ausgeprägte Eigenständigkeit und saubere Priorisierung unter Last

  • Zahlen- und Datenaffinität. Du arbeitest sicher mit Traffic- und Performance-Metriken und leitest daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, Englisch verhandlungssicher

Nice-to-have

  • Verständnis von Web Performance, Core Web Vitals und dem Google CrUX Report

  • Erfahrung mit HubSpot oder einem vergleichbaren CRM

  • E-Commerce-Hintergrund, idealerweise mit Shopsystemen wie Shopify, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopware oder Magento


Warum einsteigen?


  • Wir richten dir deinen Arbeitsplatz ein - vom Bildschirm bis zum Bürostuhl

  • Wähle dein OS: Du kannst dein Betriebssystem frei wählen zwischen Mac, Windows oder Linux

  • Schönes Büro: Arbeiten im Herzen des Hamburger Schanzenviertels

  • Haustierfreundliches Büro: Du darfst gerne einen pelzigen Freund mitbringen

  • Tolle Kolleg:innen: Kompetentes und humorvolles Team

  • Flexibel arbeiten: Arbeite nach einem Vollzeit- oder Teilzeitplan

  • Flache Hierarchien: Die besten Ideen gewinnen, egal von wem

  • Event-Slots: Mehrmals im Jahr könnt ihr abstimmen, was gemacht wird - wolltest Du nicht schon immer mal mit deinen Kolleg:innen Kart fahren? Vote for it!

  • Speed.Fest: Wir treffen uns jedes Quartal alle gemeinsam in unserem HQ in Hamburg für Workshops, gutes Essen, Events und eine tolle Zeit

  • Persönliches Ausbildungsbudget: Wir helfen Dir, Deine Karriere und Deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen

  • Monatliches, flexibles Benefit Budget: 50€ pro Monat, dass Du frei auf das für Dich passende Benefit verteilen kannst - von ÖPNV über Shopping Gutscheine bis hin zur Gym-Mitgliedschaft

  • Zukunftssichere Altersvorsorge: Bringe deine Altersvorsorge mit oder lass dich von unseren Experten beraten


Countdown

4️⃣… Du teilst deinen Lebenslauf, dein LinkedIn oder Xing-Profil mit uns.

3️⃣… Wir vereinbaren ein erstes ausführliches (Video-)Gespräch mit unserem Head of Customer Success zum Kennenlernen (45~60 Minuten). 
Wenn wir beide großes Interesse haben, bekommst du danach eine Case-Study-Simulation aus unserem echten Arbeitsalltag. Aufwand: maximal 2 Stunden, mehr wollen wir dir nicht zumuten.

2️⃣… Wir vereinbaren ein Gespräch mit unserem Head of Customer Success und einem Mitglied des CSM-Teams, inklusive Präsentation deiner Case-Study-Simulation (60~90 Minuten).

1️⃣… Abschlussgespräch mit unserem CEO (ca. 30 Minuten). Passt es für beide Seiten, bereiten wir den Vertrag vor.

…0️⃣ Du steigst ein in unser Raumschiff!


Deine Ansprechperson

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Want to work on Software-Defined Defense? 

At Apex.AI, we develop safety-certified software for mobility systems and intelligent machines. Our products power applications in automotive, trucking, robotics, aerospace, agriculture, industrial automation, and defense systems.

We are hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to design and scale Apex.AI's build and release systems. You will architect and implement our build and release system solutions, which impact developer productivity company-wide and ensure that customers receive high-quality products in a timely manner.

In this role, you will work directly with European defense customers and internal product teams to design, build, deploy, and Apex.Alan. You will help customers bring real-world systems to production while contributing improvements and features back into our core platform. Find out more about Apex.Alan here and here.

This role is located in our Munich office. Authorization to work in Germany and German language skills are required.


What You Bring
  • B.S. or higher degree in a technical field with 5+ years of relevant work experience 
  • Proven experience working with cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Proven experience maintaining a cross-platform build system 
  • Proven experience managing CI/CD pipelines 
  • Proven ability to script in Python and Starlark 
  • Proven experience building C/C++ projects with Bazel
  • Familiarity with GitLab or GitHub 
  • Experience navigating Linux-based systems and tools in a terminal
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills  
  • Excellent communication skills 
  • German language skills

    • Nice To Have
  • Experience with infrastructure management tools such as Terraform 
  • Experience with Bazel internals 
  • Familiarity with releasing code and binaries to customers 
  • Familiarity with cross-compilation 
  • Experience with the usage of CMake 
  • Experience developing Bazel infrastructure 

    • Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF.

    The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

    • Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D.
    • Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API.

    Additionally, Apex.AI offers:

    • Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process.
    • Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems.

    Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems. Through its innovative software solutions and strategic partnerships, Apex.AI is at the forefront of transforming the mobility industry, facilitating the development of next-generation vehicles and systems.

Plexal operates at the intersection of government, industry and emerging technology, helping organisations turn innovation ambition into practical capability, adoption and measurable impact.
 
The Senior Lead, Government Innovation & Economic Growth will play a critical role in shaping and delivering Plexal's growth across government. This is a nationally focused role responsible for identifying, shaping and securing high-value opportunities across central government, public sector organisations and strategic partners.
 
Based in the North West, the role will help position Plexal at the forefront of the UK's evolving government and innovation landscape. As government influence, investment and decision-making become increasingly distributed beyond Whitehall, the role will help Plexal identify and capitalise on emerging opportunities across government, economic growth, public sector reform, innovation adoption and place-based investment.
 
The successful candidate will combine strong commercial leadership with deep government insight, helping Plexal understand where policy, funding and customer priorities are moving and translating those trends into strategic opportunities, partnerships and sustainable revenue growth.
 
This is a hands-on commercial leadership role combining business development, strategic relationship management, proposition development and opportunity leadership, while also acting as a senior advisor to the wider GTM and leadership teams.


What You'll Do

  • Government Growth & Opportunity Leadership
    • Identify, prioritise and lead the pursuit of high-value opportunities across UK government. 
    • Build and maintain senior relationships across government departments, agencies, arm's-length bodies and wider public sector organisations. 
    • Shape early-stage opportunities by aligning customer priorities, policy developments and commercial propositions. 
    • Lead complex multi-stakeholder pursuits from early engagement through to contract award. 
    • Navigate government procurement and commercial environments, ensuring Plexal is well positioned to maximise success. 
    • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of government priorities, funding mechanisms and investment strategies to identify future opportunities ahead of formal procurement.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategic Positioning
    • Develop deep insight into emerging government priorities including economic growth, innovation adoption, AI, cyber resilience, public sector reform, science and technology, and place-based investment. 
    • Translate policy, market and customer insight into actionable growth opportunities for Plexal. 
    • Help shape Plexal's understanding of where government priorities, investment and demand are evolving. 
    • Identify emerging markets, funding streams and policy-driven opportunities that align with Plexal's strategic objectives. 
    • Position Plexal as a trusted partner capable of helping government translate ambition into adoption and measurable impact.
  • Cross-Government Go-To-Market Leadership
    • Shape and co-own Plexal's cross-government go-to-market strategy. 
    • Identify priority growth areas, departments and opportunity themes aligned to Plexal's strengths. 
    • Support the development and refinement of propositions that respond to changing government needs. 
    • Build repeatable approaches to opportunity identification, qualification and pursuit. 
    • Strengthen commercial discipline and opportunity management across the organisation. 
    • Support the creation of scalable propositions that can be applied across multiple government customers and sectors.
  • Strategic Relationship Management & Ecosystem Development
    • Act as a senior external representative for Plexal across government, industry and innovation ecosystem engagements. 
    • Build trusted relationships with senior government leaders, policy makers, commercial stakeholders and delivery partners. 
    • Establish Plexal as a credible voice within conversations around innovation, technology adoption, economic growth and government transformation. 
    • Build relationships across emerging government and innovation ecosystems outside London as government investment and decision-making continues to evolve. 
    • Represent Plexal at senior meetings, industry forums, conferences and government-facing events.
  • Partnerships & Growth Enablement
    • Develop strategic relationships with consultancies, technology providers, universities, ecosystem partners and delivery organisations. 
    • Build and shape consortium opportunities where partner-led approaches strengthen Plexal's position. 
    • Support priority bids, negotiations and commercial pursuits across the wider organisation. 
    • Share best practice across government sales, account development and opportunity shaping. 
    • Mentor and support colleagues across the commercial and delivery teams to strengthen capability and confidence.
  • KPIs and Commercial Outcomes
    • Significant £m pipeline generated and influenced across government markets. 
    • Material revenue secured through direct and partner-led opportunities. 
    • Number and quality of strategic opportunities shaped prior to procurement. 
    • Growth in multi-year and repeatable revenue opportunities. 
    • Conversion rate improvement across priority pursuits. 
    • Growth in partner-led opportunities and consortium wins. 
    • Strength and depth of senior relationships across government and strategic partners.
    • Contribution to Plexal's long-term positioning across government innovation, adoption and economic growth markets.


Your Skills

  • Commercially driven, outcome-focused and highly proactive. 
  • Naturally curious about government priorities, policy developments and market trends. 
  • Highly credible operating at senior levels across government and industry. 
  • Strong relationship builder with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholder groups. 
  • Strategic thinker capable of translating insight into action. 
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and shaping undefined opportunities. 
  • Collaborative and committed to enabling the success of others. 
  • Resilient, adaptable and able to thrive in fast-moving environments.


Your Experience

Essential:

  • Proven track record of selling into UK government and winning complex public sector opportunities. 
  • Demonstrable success securing and growing contracts valued at £1m+ and/or multi-year engagements. 
  • Strong understanding of government procurement, commercial processes and public sector buying environments. 
  • Experience building relationships with senior government stakeholders. 
  • Strong commercial acumen including opportunity shaping, negotiation and deal strategy. 
  • Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies in complex environments. 
  • Experience working with partners to shape and deliver consortium bids and strategic opportunities. 
  • Ability to operate effectively across strategy, relationship management and hands-on opportunity delivery. 
  • Strong understanding of the relationship between government policy, funding, investment priorities and commercial opportunity.
 
Highly desirable:
  • Experience working across multiple government departments or policy domains. 
  • Understanding of economic growth, devolution, place-based investment and public sector reform. 
  • Experience within innovation, technology, consulting, digital transformation, cyber or AI-related environments. 
  • Experience identifying and developing opportunities arising from policy change, government reform and market shifts. 
  • Existing network across UK government, strategic partners and innovation ecosystems. 
  • Experience operating within high-growth, entrepreneurial or scaling organisations. 
  • Familiarity with government priorities relating to AI adoption, cyber resilience, science and technology, productivity and economic growth.


Who You Are

  • Willingness to undertake regular national travel (>40%) and occasional international travel
  • Open to UK Nationals who hold or are eligible for Security Check (SC) clearance. (See more on clearance eligibility.)
  • Degree-level education or equivalent professional experience
  • Relevant commercial, consulting or public sector credentials are advantageous
  • Commitment to Plexal’s values of diversity, equity, and inclusion


Why us?

As a start-up, we thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment dedicated to empowering innovators. We embrace individuals who leverage technology and creativity to tackle our greatest challenges head-on. We strongly advocate for maintaining a harmonious work-life balance, our goal is to ensure every member of our team can authentically be themselves and live their best lives. We firmly believe that innovation and creativity flourish when we cultivate a diverse workforce, comprising highly skilled individuals with a wide range of perspectives to contribute.
 
In return we will offer you:

  • Salary: £80,000 - £100,000 depending on skills and experience
  • Annual bonus scheme
  • A generous pension scheme (with a company contribution of up to 10%)
  • Private healthcare, life assurance and critical illness cover
  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • Volunteering day
Plexal is an equal opportunities employer and we actively encourage applicants from individuals from all backgrounds. We are a Disability Committed employer and are willing to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

jobs.description:
About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Yepoda is a clean K-Beauty brand that actually proves it works. We make Korean skincare without any of the compromises. Everything is clinically tested, 100% vegan, and formulated above EU standards. So you get the innovation and the results that K-Beauty is known for, plus a real commitment to sustainability. And we make it genuinely fun and easy to use — skincare you actually look forward to.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a certified B Corp™ and 1% for the Planet member, based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available through our own online shop and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe — online and in over 650 stores. With a team of 140+ brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda's story every day.

The Opportunity

Yepoda is growing fast across Europe and expanding internationally, and we're building our first field team. This is your chance to be part of it from day one.

You'll be Yepoda's representative inside Sephora UK, not a Beauty Advisor, but a field based commercial role. You'll drive sell-out in your doors, train and coach Sephora's Beauty Advisor teams, own the store relationships, and keep our brand presentation flawless in store. Part account executive, part field trainer, part retail sales lead. You'll be responsible for the relationship, education, and sell-out across five Sephora doors in London.

  • Travel: Up to 20% of your time, subject to change by season and business needs. Covers your doors plus occasional support at Yepoda events. Yepoda will cover travel expenses (accommodation, transportation, and meal allowance).

  • Location: London, UK. Field-based retail role (in-store at assigned Sephora location, mobile as needed)

Your Tasks

  • Own sell-out across your doors and deliver against monthly and quarterly targets

  • Negotiate and run dedicated brand moments including sales challenges, Beauty Hub takeovers, and fun days

  • Train Sephora Beauty Advisor teams on our products, routines, and brand story, from quick floor briefings to full breakfast sessions

  • Coach Sephora staff on selling technique, routine building, and cross-selling

  • Deliver launch education so every new product lands with a confident floor team behind it

  • Assist the EU Retail & Education Manager in large scale education events and press days

  • Provide weekly field reports covering sell-out by door, merchandising, and tester photos

  • Relay competitor activity and customer insight that shapes our commercial plans

Your Profile

  • 2 to 5 years in prestige cosmetic sales and education, or a senior Beauty Advisor ready to take their career to the next level, Sephora experience strongly preferred

  • A track record of driving sell-out in a retail environment

  • Confident delivering training, in-store events, and product demonstrations to a floor team

  • Commercially minded and customer centric with excellent interpersonal and communication skills

  • Genuinely self directed and highly organised, you run your doors and own your reporting

  • Passionate about skincare with real energy for the floor, K-Beauty knowledge is a big plus

  • Fluent English

  • Based in London with the right to work in the UK


What We Offer

  • Join a top, rapidly growing, K-Beauty brand. Fast growth across Europe, international expansion, and a brand people are excited to see in store.

  • The original field team. Be part of the original field team, with potential transition to permanent opportunity.

  • Real autonomy and opportunity to own your role. You own your market, run your doors and are trusted to make decisions in your scope.

  • Education & Development: Comprehensive onboarding, ongoing product and sales training, and direct mentorship from our EU Sales & Education Manager to develop advanced education techniques, presentation skills, and retail expertise.

  • The practical perks. Quarterly product gratis plus a generous employee discount; a performance linked bonus tied to your stores' sell-out (structure agreed separately).

(Senior) Embedded Software Engineer - Reliant
jobs.description:
As an Embedded Software Engineer, you are a key member of our Architecture team, developing and implementing the core embedded software that enables our autonomous long-range VTOL platforms to operate safely, reliably, and intelligently in highly demanding operational environments.

In this role, you will be dedicated to our Reliant platform – our next-generation long-range VTOL UAS designed for autonomous ISR missions in GNSS-denied and contested environments. You will contribute to mission-critical software that powers autonomous flight, resilient navigation, payload integration, and edge computing capabilities for defense and security customers worldwide.

Together with our world-class team, you will push the boundaries of autonomous aviation, working closely with System Architecture, Flight Controls, AI, Hardware Development, Integration & Test, and Flight Operations to continuously improve Reliant's performance, reliability, and mission capabilities.



What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Design, implement, maintain, and optimize the Quantum-Systems embedded firmware stack for the Reliant platform

  • Develop safety-critical flight software for autonomous long-range VTOL operations

  • Design, implement, and validate new flight control, navigation, and mission management functionalities

  • Export flight control and navigation algorithms from MATLAB/Simulink and integrate them into the embedded autopilot framework

  • Implement, optimize, and maintain BSPs, peripheral drivers, communication interfaces, and sensor drivers

  • Develop embedded software for redundant and safety-critical avionics architectures

  • Integrate navigation sensors including IMUs, GNSS, magnetometers, air-data sensors, radar altimeters, and vision-based navigation systems

  • Support autonomous navigation capabilities in GNSS-denied environments through sensor fusion technologies

  • Develop and optimize communication interfaces for long-range command & control systems, payload communication, and vehicle subsystems

  • Support the integration of modular payloads including EO/IR sensors, SIGINT, EW, SAR, CRPA, and future mission systems

  • Contribute to robust firmware architectures enabling reliable operation in contested and degraded environments

  • Build, document, maintain, and continuously improve autopilot firmware

  • Prepare flight test releases, create flight test tickets, analyze flight logs, and support flight test campaigns

  • Debug and trace embedded software to improve robustness, code coverage, and system reliability

  • Maintain bootloaders, secure firmware update mechanisms, and firmware deployment processes

  • Improve firmware build systems, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing infrastructure (GitLab CI)

  • Support production, manufacturing, and hardware validation tools

  • Collaborate closely with AI and Edge Computing teams to integrate onboard processing capabilities into embedded flight systems

  • Contribute to software architecture, coding standards, and continuous improvement of development processes



What you bring to the team:

  • Several years of experience developing embedded software for microcontroller-based systems

  • Excellent programming skills in C, with modern embedded software design principles

  • Experience with C++ is considered a plus

  • Strong understanding of ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers and embedded hardware architectures

  • Excellent knowledge of communication protocols including UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet, and serial communication interfaces

  • Experience working with RTOS-based embedded systems (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, uC/OS or similar)

  • Experience with low-level driver development, BSP implementation, and hardware abstraction layers

  • Good understanding of embedded bootloaders, firmware updates, and secure software deployment

  • Experience with debugging embedded systems using JTAG/SWD, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and similar tools

  • Ability to read electronic schematics and work closely with hardware engineers

  • Experience with Git, GitLab, and CI/CD-based embedded software development

  • Understanding of autopilot architectures and flight control software

  • Experience with sensor fusion, inertial navigation, or autonomous systems is highly desirable

  • Familiarity with UAV systems, robotics, aerospace, or autonomous vehicles is considered a strong advantage

  • Knowledge of safety-critical software development, fault-tolerant system design, or high-reliability embedded software is a plus

  • Experience integrating complex sensors or payload systems into embedded platforms is beneficial

  • Interest in autonomous flight systems, long-range navigation, and mission-critical aerospace applications

  • Highly self-motivated with a structured, solution-oriented working style

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams

  • Fluent English (minimum B2)


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test - Show Production
jobs.description:
The ideal candidate is

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test who thrives at the intersection of software engineering, audio technology, and product quality.

You have a strong engineering mindset, deep curiosity about how complex systems behave, and practical experience testing audio software in real-world environments. You are comfortable working close to the code, designing robust test automation, debugging across software and hardware boundaries, and helping teams build products that are reliable, observable, and easy to validate.

At HOLOPLOT, software is central to the design, configuration, deployment, monitoring, and operation of sound systems.

Our show production team has been working on a wide range of audio applications/plugins for immersive audio content production that will work hand in hand with our sound system. Testing such applications and plugins requires more than checking whether features work. It requires an understanding of signal flow, timing, synchronization, real-time constraints, interoperability, and how audio systems fail in practice. It also requires creating representable mocks and setups that are effective, economical, and maintainable.


Your role and responsibilities

As a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test in this team, you will partner closely with software engineers and product designers to define test strategies, build automation, and validate complex workflows across desktop applications, audio plugins, networked audio systems, and spatial audio features. You will develop automated, scalable test frameworks, explore test infrastructure, and increase confidence in release cycles.

You will work on both black-box and white-box testing approaches, depending on the problem: from backend-driven end-to-end tests to signal-analysis-based tests, UI validation, and system-level regression tests.

You will help integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and improve the reliability, runtime, debuggability, and maintainability of the test suite.

You will create test tools that make it easier to automatically capture, analyze, compare, and validate audio behavior.

You will help teams move from manual validation toward reproducible, deterministic, and observable test workflows.


What you need to succeed in this role

Your skills and qualifications

  • A proven track record as a Software Development Engineer in Test, or Software Engineer with a strong focus on quality and automation.

  • Professional experience in the audio industry, preferably overlapping with the following fields: desktop audio applications, audio plugins, Audio-over-IP, spatial audio and immersive sound experience, embedded audio systems.

  • Strong programming skills in at least one general-purpose language such as Python.

  • Knowledge of C++ with a wish to learn more.

  • Experience designing and maintaining automated test frameworks, integration tests, end-to-end tests, and CI-based validation workflows.

  • A good understanding of digital audio fundamentals.

  • Experience testing desktop applications, in all major platforms.

  • Experience with audio plugin testing.

  • Good understanding of software architecture, testability, observability, and maintainable engineering practices.

  • Strong communication skills in English. You can explain technical risks, test strategies, and failure modes clearly to developers, product stakeholders, and non-specialists.

  • An eye for detail, a tad of perfectionism, a can-do mentality, and the courage to take on new challenges

  • A mindset of curiosity and excellence

  • Positive vibes and desire to contribute to a productive and collegial working environment


Nice to haves

  • Experience with networked audio or real-time network protocols is highly valuable, especially AES67, Ravenna, Dante, RTP, PTP, multicast, or related technologies.

  • Experience with spatial audio technologies.

  • Experience testing multi-channel audio systems or large-scale professional audio installations.


We offer you

At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. Pay is competitive and fair, and we offer perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme.

You’ll join an international, open-minded team across software, hardware, product and research, in an environment with plenty of autonomy and ownership. You’ll work on cutting-edge audio technology, turn complex requirements into working solutions and contribute to global projects, with support for your growth through individual development plans, mentoring and coaching.

jobs.description:

Du arbeitest dort, wo zentrale Informationen zusammenlaufen, Entscheidungen vorbereitet, Prioritäten gesetzt und strategische Initiativen in die Umsetzung gebracht werden.

Aufgaben

Als Executive Assistant to the CEO arbeitest du unmittelbar mit dem CEO zusammen und fungierst als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Geschäftsführung, Führungskräften, internen Bereichen sowie ausgewählten externen Stakeholdern.

Dazu strukturierst du komplexe Sachverhalte, bereitest Entscheidungen vor, steuerst Managementprozesse, hältst strategische Initiativen nach und stellst sicher, dass aus Entscheidungen konkrete Ergebnisse entstehen.

Du erhältst einen außergewöhnlich tiefen Einblick in die Führung und Weiterentwicklung eines wachsenden Unternehmens und übernimmst früh Verantwortung für Themen mit hoher strategischer Relevanz.

Deine Verantwortungsbereiche

CEO Office & Executive Management

  • unmittelbare Unterstützung des CEO bei strategischen, operativen und organisatorischen Fragestellungen

Du übernimmst eigenständig ausgewählte strategische Projekte und Sonderthemen des CEO.

Dazu können beispielsweise gehören:

  • strategische Unternehmensinitiativen
  • Aufbau neuer Geschäftsbereiche
  • Organisations- und Strukturprojekte
  • Kooperationen und strategische Partnerschaften
  • Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen
  • Evaluierung neuer Geschäftsmodelle
  • Vorbereitung von Investitions- oder Business Cases
  • gesellschaftsübergreifende Projekte

Du koordinierst dabei unterschiedliche Stakeholder und stellst sicher, dass Projekte nicht bei Konzepten oder Beschlüssen stehen bleiben, sondern konsequent umgesetzt werden.

Management Steering & Performance

Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung einer professionellen Unternehmenssteuerung.

Hierzu gehören insbesondere:

  • Weiterentwicklung von Management-KPIs und Reporting-Strukturen

Dabei geht es nicht darum, Zahlen lediglich zusammenzutragen. Wir erwarten, dass du Zusammenhänge erkennst, Fragen stellst und daraus konkrete Handlungsoptionen ableitest.

Executive Communication & Stakeholder Management

Dazu gehören beispielsweise:

Das Ziel ist, Zeit, Aufmerksamkeit und Entscheidungsfähigkeit des CEO möglichst wirkungsvoll einzusetzen.

Qualifikation

  • verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Erfahrung im Gaming- oder eSport-Umfeld ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Entscheidender sind für uns intellektuelle Neugier, Leistungsbereitschaft, Urteilsvermögen und die Fähigkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Was dich auszeichnet

Für diese Rolle suchen wir jemanden, der nicht auf Arbeitsaufträge wartet.

Du erkennst selbstständig,

  • welche Informationen fehlen,
  • welche Entscheidung erforderlich ist,
  • welche Person eingebunden werden muss,
  • wo ein Projekt ins Stocken gerät und
  • was als Nächstes passieren muss.

Du kannst zwischen wichtig und dringend unterscheiden und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Themen den Überblick.

Du bist gleichermaßen in der Lage, eine Management-Präsentation vorzubereiten, einen Business Case kritisch zu hinterfragen, ein strategisches Projekt zu koordinieren und einen vertraulichen Vorgang mit höchster Diskretion zu behandeln.

Absolute Integrität und Vertraulichkeit setzen wir voraus.

Benefits

Direkter Zugang zur Unternehmensführung

Du arbeitest unmittelbar mit dem CEO zusammen und erhältst Einblick in zentrale strategische, finanzielle, organisatorische und operative Entscheidungen.

Außergewöhnlich breite Verantwortung

Statt eines eng definierten Aufgabenbereichs arbeitest du an Themen aus unterschiedlichen Funktionen und Geschäftsbereichen.

Sichtbarer Einfluss

Deine Arbeit fließt unmittelbar in Entscheidungen, Projekte und die Weiterentwicklung des Unternehmens ein.

Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
🌍 About Outpost

Global expansion is broken. Without a local entity, conversion rates fall, costs rise, and compliance gets messy. Outpost fixes it.

Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce. Pick only what you need - tax, payments, treasury, or operations - and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we act as Merchant of Record, taking on tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself.

Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise.

🧠 The Role

We're hiring a second Executive Assistant to support our CEO.

We already have an EA, and she isn't going anywhere. You'll report to the CEO and work alongside her: she keeps inbound, customer routing and the investor-facing side, takes diary, travel, logistics, internal admin, and hiring coordination. You'll join to take a defined set of workstreams off that plate.

Roughly 70% of this role is executive support. The other 30% is hiring - and that's where the leverage is. We run a five-stage interview loop across engineering, ops, product, GTM and tax, hiring around two people a month. Someone needs to own the machinery: scheduling across five calendars and four countries, keeping candidates warm, chasing feedback, making sure nobody good goes cold because a diary didn't line up.

This is a role for someone early in their career who is unusually organised and wants to learn how a company actually gets built. You won't be handed a finished process. You'll be shown how we do things today, and expected to make it better.

🧩 What You'll Do

Own the CEO's diary and logistics

  • Run scheduling day to day - booking, moving, protecting focus time, resolving clashes before they become problems

  • Book and manage international travel, and rebuild it when a flight moves

  • Prepare meeting packs: who's in the room, what they want, what happened last time

  • Track and chase the follow-ups nobody wrote down

Do the work he never sees

  • The highest-value work here is invisible. He shouldn't know it happened - he should just find the day went smoothly

  • Fix problems before they reach him: the double-booking, the missing dial-in, the visa that needed renewing

  • Do the quiet prep - background on a person he's meeting, what was agreed last time, the numbers checked before a deck goes out

  • Anticipate. If a trip is booked, the transfer, the dinner and the buffer around the flight are already handled

  • The fewer questions he has to ask you, the better you're doing the job

Own hiring coordination

  • Run scheduling across the full interview loop - five stages, multiple interviewers, several time zones

  • Keep the pipeline clean: trackers, interview feedback, stage-by-stage conversion

  • Build target lists for open roles and help manage outreach

  • Be the candidate's point of contact - fast, warm, human. How we treat candidates is how we're judged

  • Coordinate offers, references, contracts, start dates, and new-hire onboarding logistics

Keep the company running

  • Support board and investor prep alongside the CEO, Chief of Staff and our senior EA

  • Help run internal comms: all-hands, offsites, company updates

  • Manage supplier, tooling and expense admin so nobody else has to think about it

  • Spot the recurring problem and fix it permanently rather than solving it again next week

💥 Example Projects

  • Rebuild a full week of CEO travel in an afternoon after a fundraising meeting moves

  • Take time-to-offer from three weeks to ten days by fixing scheduling and feedback bottlenecks

  • Build the candidate tracker that shows conversion at every interview stage, and run it weekly

  • Own the logistics for a board meeting: pre-reads, agenda, materials, follow-ups

  • Organise a company offsite for a team split across London, Amsterdam and beyond

  • Write down how you do your job so the next person can pick it up in a week

🧱 What We're Looking For

Ideal background:

  • 1–3 years in an EA, team assistant, recruiting coordinator or ops support role - ideally at a startup or fast-growing tech / fintech company

  • Any recruiting coordination exposure is a plus, but we'll teach it if you're quick

  • Comfortable in a company without much process, because you've worked in one before

  • Fluent with modern tooling (Notion, Slack, Linear, ATS, scheduling tools and AI) and quick to pick up new ones

  • Excellent written English. You'll write on the CEO's behalf

Signals we care about:

  • Ridiculous bias for action - you solve, not observe

  • Extremely organised, and visibly so. Nothing gets dropped, nothing needs chasing twice

  • Strong EQ - you know how to read a room, a candidate, or a blocker

  • Sound judgement - you know what to decide yourself and what to escalate, and you sit on neither

  • Discreet. You'll see comp, term sheets and candidate conversations before most of the team

  • Curious and resourceful - you can figure anything out

  • You improve what you touch. The second time you do something, it should be faster than the first

What this role is not:

  • Not a diary-only role - you'll own hiring, onboarding and internal operations too

  • Not a pure recruiter role - hiring is a third of the job, not the whole of it

  • Not a role for someone who needs defined processes and hierarchy to be effective

  • Not a stepping stone you can coast through. The exposure is real, and so is the pace

🚀 Why This Role Is Different

Most assistant roles are about keeping someone else's life tidy. This one is about making a company move faster.

You'll own hiring coordination, which at our stage is one of the highest-leverage things we do — the people you help bring in will shape what Outpost becomes. And you'll get a front-row view of a Series A fintech being built, with two people above you invested in teaching you how it works.

We expect whoever is in this role to grow rapidly, and we'll back you every step of the way.

🦾 Outpost Team

Our team were leaders at Revolut, Airwallex, Adyen, Sumup and Wayflyer - and we're backed by top-tier investors who have built or backed some of the world's leading fintechs.

🧾 What We Offer

  • Equity and salary in a well-funded startup

  • Ability to own your work and move fast

  • World-class training from operators who've scaled globally

  • A global mission with real impact

  • Low politics, high output

  • Chance to grow into a senior role fast

  • A culture of builders, not talkers

Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

At DeepL, we're on an exciting adventure to expand our operations to match our ambitious growth plans. At the heart of this journey is our Sales team, a cornerstone of DeepL's market expansion and customer engagement strategy.

Our mission is clear: to build and develop high-performing sales teams that embody DeepL's innovative spirit and drive for excellence. As a member of our Sales team, you will be at the forefront of driving our growth and expanding our global reach. Working in close partnership with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams, you will collaborate to deliver tailored solutions that meet the needs of our clients.

Your responsibilities

  • Own territory design globally — coverage models, segmentation, and account assignments — across the annual planning cycle, working directly with sales managers and our regional Sales Strategy Business Partners.

  • Model and monitor. Build territory and ownership scenarios across Salesforce, Google Sheets, and Databricks, then track how territories perform once they're live: which patches are working, what's selling where, and where coverage needs rebalancing.

  • Build target-account strategies grounded in our product, partnering with Product, Data Analytics & Insights, and Marketing Operations to sharpen our ICP by region and focus coverage where it's most likely to convert.

  • Own our sales policies and Rules of Engagement — where reps can and can't sell, how ownership decisions get made, and what happens when the rules are breached. These exist today; rebuilding them properly is yours.

  • Automate the manual work. This role is roughly 40% operational today and we want it closer to fully strategic. You'll have our backing to use AI tools like Claude, and the partnership of our Systems and Operations teams, to get it there.

  • Keep the foundations clean. Be the strategy voice in Salesforce roadmap reviews so changes don't quietly break territories or reporting, and handle day-to-day account reallocation as people join, move, and leave.

Qualities we look for

  • Around 3–5 years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Go-to-Market Strategy, or sales planning. We care more about what you've owned than the number on your CV.

  • Highly analytical. You're comfortable getting into the data across Sheets, Salesforce, and Databricks to test an idea, and you land on a clear, defensible recommendation rather than a deck of options.

  • Confident reasoning about Salesforce — how accounts, territories, ownership, and data fit together. This is not an admin or technical role, and we have strong Systems and Operations teams behind you, but you need to hold your own in those conversations. Hands-on backend experience is a bonus, not a requirement.

  • Able to influence without authority. A lot of the change you'll drive sits in other teams, so you'll get there through insight, evidence, and constructive challenge.

  • A strong bias to automate. You already use AI tools such as Claude to remove repetitive work, or you have a genuine appetite to learn how.

  • Proactive. You spot the problem, work out what to do about it, and go and do it. We don't need someone who arrives with all the answers — we need someone who goes and finds them.

  • Comfortable with real deadlines. Planning season doesn't move and it's intense. The rest of the year is calmer and more about building for the next cycle.

  • Experience in tech at scale is a plus — somewhere you've seen what good looks like and can bring that standard with you.

  • Collaborative across regions and disciplines, with the energy and drive to work well with Sales, Product, Revenue Intelligence, and Marketing Operations.

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

If this sounds interesting, please apply! Studies by several different sources have shown that on average men will apply for a job if they meet 60% of the application requirements. If you're not sure you're the right fit, apply anyway and let us know what you bring to the table. We'd love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Chief Revenue Officer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
WER WIR SIND

Wir sind ein junges, schnell wachsendes IT-Consulting-Unternehmen. Für unsere Kunden sind wir Problemlöser in den Bereichen Customer Service, CRM und AI. Dies erreichen wir mit viel Kreativität, Transparenz und Ehrgeiz, was uns bei Kunden von Start-ups bis hin zu Konzernen zu bewährten Partnern macht.


LEAVE YOUR FOOTPRINT

Als erster Chief Revenue Officer bei Leafworks übernimmst Du eine Schlüsselrolle für unsere nächste Wachstumsphase.

  • Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung entwickelst Du unsere kommerzielle Strategie weiter.

  • Du baust Sales, Marketing, Customer Success und Partner Management zu einer gemeinsamen Commercial Organisation aus.

  • Du schaffst Strukturen für nachhaltiges und profitables Wachstum.

  • Du gestaltest die Zukunft von Leafworks aktiv mit – mit Perspektive auf die Geschäftsführung.


DEIN TALENT

Du bist kein klassischer Vertriebsleiter und auch kein Konzern-CRO. Du denkst unternehmerisch, handelst pragmatisch und packst selbst mit an.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer Commercial-, Revenue- oder Sales-Führungsrolle

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge beim Aufbau von profitablem Wachstum

  • Erfahrung mit Enterprise Sales oder Value Selling

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau strukturierter Sales- und Revenue-Prozesse

  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM, Forecasting und Pipeline Management

  • Verständnis für Marketing, Customer Success und Account Management

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch

  • Idealerweise Erfahrung im Consulting-, SaaS- oder Software-Umfeld


HAVE AN IMPACT

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung unserer kommerziellen Wachstumsstrategie

  • Ausbau der Neukundengewinnung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Sales-Ansatzes

  • Aufbau einer nachhaltigen Lead-Pipeline gemeinsam mit Marketing

  • Professionalisierung unseres Key Account Managements und Ausbau von Cross- und Upselling

  • Weiterentwicklung von CRM, Forecasting, Pricing und Sales-Prozessen

  • Optimierung der Zusammenarbeit zwischen Sales, Consulting, Entwicklung und Customer Success

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und aktive Mitgestaltung unserer nächsten Unternehmensphase

  • Positionierung unserer AI- und Customer-Experience-Lösungen im Markt


WARUM LEAFWORKS

Wir sind ein internationales, bunt gemischtes, ähnlich tickendes Team. Wir schauen erst aufs Menschliche und danach auf die Skills, in dieser Reihenfolge. Egal welche Ausbildung Du hast, wie alt Du bist, wo Du wohnst, wo Du herkommst oder wie dein Lebenslauf aussieht: Come as you are and be yourself!

  • Mikro-Management ist nicht dein Stil? Unserer auch nicht: Du kannst dir deine Arbeitszeit selbst einteilen und wir arbeiten 100 % remote. Ab und zu mal Lust auf ein Co-Working mit LWees in deiner Nähe? Jederzeit gerne.

  • Das Ergebnis zählt: Wie Du arbeitest, entscheidest Du. 

  • Vertrauensbasis: Vertrauen ist alles. Punkt.

  • Remote is where the magic happens: Was Du zum Arbeiten an Equipment brauchst, bekommst Du. 

  • Get to the Next level: Weiterbildungen, Trainings oder Schulungen? Sprich uns direkt an, auch das gehört dazu.

  • Stay connected: Durch regelmäßigen Austausch und Feedback-Talks leben wir Transparenz und Offenheit.

  • Prepare for challenges: Langweilige Projekte wirst Du bei uns nicht finden. Sei bereit, aus deiner Komfortzone rauszukommen.

  • Here to stay: Wir bauen auf langfristige Zusammenarbeit. Befristete Arbeitsverträge haben wir nicht.

  • Dresscode: Nein danke. 

  • Das WIR zählt: Durch die zahlreichen Co-Workings und Teamevents in Deutschland und im Ausland stärken wir unseren Zusammenhalt und unsere ganz besondere LW-Kultur.

  • Starte direkt durch: Ein Onboarding, das dich ankommen lässt. Dein Onboarding-Buddy steht dir ab dem ersten Tag zur Seite.


Hört sich cool an? Super, dann schick uns doch einfach deinen Lebenslauf. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht!

jobs.title: AI Engineer
Associate, Talent Acquisition
Senior Robotics Software Engineer Counter UAV Systems - Generalist (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
What we offer

  • Work in an international, agile team creating the future of autonomous systems
  • Grow your career in a expanding and ambitious engineering team
  • Build innovative products using state-of-the-art technologies in AI, robotics, and autonomy 
  • Benefit from a steep learning curve and continuous development
  • Enjoy team events and a strong, collaborative culture


Your mission

Build real autonomous systems that operate in the real world, not in the lab. 
Join our engineering team and help build the core autonomy that powers our next generation robotic systems used for defense and mission-critical operations. You will design, implement, and harden robotic software that must perform under real operational conditions : outdoors, under uncertainty, with real consequences. Your work will directly shape the reliability, safety, and tactical capability of the systems we deliver.  You will contribute to the development and integration of core robotic capabilities, including: 

  • Designing and implementing robust, real-time robotics software components
  • Working with multi-modal sensor data, ensuring timing, synchronization, and frame correctness 
  • Developing and improving algorithms in areas such as estimation, perception, planning, control, or integration 
  • Ensuring deterministic behavior, reliability, and system-level stability 
  • Debugging and validating robotic systems during field tests, under real-world constraints 
  • Collaborating with a cross-functional team of robotics, embedded, and domain experts 
  • Maintaining high engineering standards: code reviews, CI, reproducible builds, documentation 
You will execute on real hardware and iterate based on operational performance, field results are the final metric.


Your profile

Technical Fundamentals :

  • Strong proficiency in modern C++ (17/20) 
  • Experience with ROS/ ROS 2
  • Solid foundation in algorithms, data structures, and numerical methods 
  • Experience developing software that runs on real robots, embedded systems, or hardware-in-the-loop setups 
  • Comfortable working with raw sensor data (timing, noise characteristics, transforms, calibration) 
  • Strong debugging skills: runtime issues, latency, performance bottlenecks, integration failures 
  • Ability to architect clean, modular, maintainable software systems 

Robotics Foundation :

  • Understanding of at least one robotics domain: state estimation, perception, tracking, planning, control, sensor fusion, or integration 
  • Ability to reason about real-time behavior, latency budgets, and reliability requirements 
  • End-to-end thinking: understanding how individual modules affect the whole system 


Nice to have

  • Python for tooling or prototyping 
  • Experience with robotics middleware or real-time systems 
  • Background in optimization, filtering, or physical modeling 
  • Experience with embedded platforms, GPUs, or simulation tools 
  • We hire for core engineering ability, everything else can be learned here.


What else

  • Builder mentality: you ship working solutions, not theoretical concepts 
  • Hands-on ownership: you proactively solve problems, even outside your direct scope 
  • Field-driven mindset: you care about what survives real operations, not “lab perfect” 
  • High quality bar: you aim for reliability, determinism, and clarity in your engineering 
  • Startup drive: you execute fast despite ambiguity, and adapt quickly 
  • Mission alignment: genuine motivation to work on defense-relevant, safety-critical robotics 
  • Nationality of a NATO member nation or close ally is required
